0036-05-02/faunterra.t: Agatha’s dilemma: the Shavans break into Faunterra, and Wilhelm turns the Fingers against people for the first time.

0572-01-01/grot-kosuli.t: Baron Arthur Agatha meets Abbot Valensius at the Roe Deer Grotto: the beginning of the rise of Agatha’s North.

0735-01-01/yuzhnyj-put.t: The Lightbearers seize the whole northern part of the Southern Way in four months.

1500-01-01/serdtse-sveta.label: 16th century
1500-01-01/serdtse-sveta.t: The Horse Wars: Heart of Light holds off Darian the Vile’s army for a year. The Duchy of Hope emerges after the wars.

1750-01-01/almera-zemlya.label: c. 1750
1750-01-01/almera-zemlya.t: The Golden War: House Lightheart attacks Almera.

1755-10-26/faunterra.label: October 1755
1755-10-26/faunterra.t: The Jester’s Conspiracy fails: Manson loses his rank and House Lightheart falls.

1756-08-01/dar-17.label: August 1756
1756-08-01/dar-17.t: The Seventeenth Gift lands near Weimar: a dead goddess is found at the landing site, and Paul emerges from the lava.

1772-01-01/aleridan.t: Ulyana’s Dust is taken from the vault of the cathedral in Aleridan. Richard Origin disappears at sea around the same time.

1774-03-21/smolden.label: 21 March 1774
1774-03-21/smolden.t: Harmon hires a guard: the merchant takes on Joaquin Eve Hanna. Sir Clive Stagforth is killed in the Forest Edge that same day.

1774-03-22/klyk-medvedya.label: 22 March 1774
1774-03-22/klyk-medvedya.t: Sybil takes in Mira: she tells the orphaned girl that she is fourth in line to the throne.

1774-03-22/pervaya-zima.label: 22 March 1774
1774-03-22/pervaya-zima.t: Erwin proposes a coalition: Desmond sends him away with the expedition as punishment.

1774-04-12/izluchina.label: 12–13 April 1774
1774-04-12/izluchina.t: Harmon receives a letter from Weimar: he meets Father David and takes refugees from Niar into his caravan, Polly among them.

1774-04-28/spot.label: Late April 1774
1774-04-28/spot.t: The expedition reaches Spot: Erwin has caught a cold by the time he arrives.

1774-05-07/faunterra.label: 7 May 1774
1774-05-07/faunterra.t: Mira reaches the capital by train under the name Gloria Northwood.

1774-05-08/uejmar.label: 8–9 May 1774
1774-05-08/uejmar.t: Vittor commissions a secret sale: he asks Harmon to sell the Light Sphere.

1774-05-15/reka.label: 14–15 May 1774
1774-05-15/reka.t: Jamis’s mutiny: Erwin suppresses the revolt in the marshes of Soft Fields.

1774-05-28/soltaun.label: Late May 1774
1774-05-28/soltaun.t: Harmon bargains over the Sphere with the Saltown buyers.

1774-06-08/dar-18.label: 8 June 1774
1774-06-08/dar-18.t: The Eighteenth Gift: the expedition finds the emptied landing site. Luis stabs Erwin that night, and the camp is massacred.

1774-06-24/labelin.label: 24 June 1774
1774-06-24/labelin.t: Maurice Labelin buys the Sphere: the duke pays Harmon 36,000 hilts, but it is a counterfeit.

1774-07-01/mon-mareka.label: 1 July 1774
1774-07-01/mon-mareka.t: Harmon takes back the real Sphere: Doxet dies, and Harmon’s shot kills Snipe and Polly.

1774-07-04/faunterra.label: 4 July 1774
1774-07-04/faunterra.t: Mira discovers the poisoning: she realizes Sybil and Gallard are poisoning her and bargains for her life and exile to a monastery.

1774-07-08/reka.label: 6–11 July 1774
1774-07-08/reka.t: Erwin and Jamis see Wilhelm’s Fingers in action and find hundreds dead beyond the River.

1774-08-10/mon-ulyany.label: August 1774
1774-08-10/mon-ulyany.t: Crybaby meets “Mia,” actually Mira, at the monastery of Ulyana the Sorrowful.

1774-08-12/zemli-korony.label: August 1774
1774-08-12/zemli-korony.t: The ambush at Lacey: Becca Litland unwittingly saves Moran.

1774-08-14/lajem.label: August 1774
1774-08-14/lajem.t: “Horam” buys Niza: at an auction in Laem he buys the Shavan woman and dreams of a balloon.

1774-08-30/pervaya-zima.label: 30 August 1774
1774-08-30/pervaya-zima.t: Erwin returns: Desmond, ravaged by stone sickness, hands power over to him.

1774-09-02/almera-zemlya.label: Night before 2 September 1774
1774-09-02/almera-zemlya.t: The fall of Evergard: the Fingers burn the castle, Aiden Almera dies, and Joaquin rescues the badly burned Alanis.

1774-09-10/pervaya-zima.label: 10 September 1774
1774-09-10/pervaya-zima.t: The Northern Flash begins: it is Erwin’s last day before marching south.

1774-09-20/uindli.label: September 1774
1774-09-20/uindli.t: The Northerners win at Windley and take the Saltown merchants’ gold.

1774-10-01/more-ldov.label: Early October 1774
1774-10-01/more-ldov.t: Fleming’s fleet sails into the Sea of Ice with Jamis and Mark, who was taken aboard in secret.

1774-10-05/uejmar.label: Early October 1774
1774-10-05/uejmar.t: Inge Price brings the freed Mira to Weimar.

1774-10-14/faunterra.label: 14 October 1774
1774-10-14/faunterra.t: The brides’ substitution is exposed: Ethan’s letter reveals it, and Sybil and Gloria are arrested.

1774-10-16/dojl.label: 15–16 October 1774
1774-10-16/dojl.t: Doyle surrenders without a siege after Erwin executes twenty-five prisoners.

1774-10-20/melorandzh.label: October 1774
1774-10-20/melorandzh.t: Moran Steppe Fire falls on Litland.

1774-11-03/labelin.label: Early November 1774
1774-11-03/labelin.t: Erwin’s army holds the Southerners at gunpoint outside Labelin without firing; the “X” fighters win the mounted contest.

1774-11-26/uejmar.label: 26 November 1774
1774-11-26/uejmar.t: Ethan and Shatterhand free Mira from Martin Shayland’s dungeon.

1774-12-02/piksi.label: 2 December 1774
1774-12-02/piksi.t: The Battle of Pixie: Alexis Smile routs the Northerners, and Craig Northwood is taken prisoner.

1774-12-02/melorandzh.label: 2 December 1774
1774-12-02/melorandzh.t: Adrian and Prince Hector drive off the Shavans near Melorange.

1774-12-07/faunterra.label: Night before 7 December 1774
1774-12-07/faunterra.t: The Northerners seize the Imperial Citadel and the Palace of Pen and Sword.

1774-12-08/labelin.label: December 1774
1774-12-08/labelin.t: Night in Labelin: Alexis’s army perishes in the city.

1774-12-22/bek-most.label: Dawn on 22 December 1774
1774-12-22/bek-most.t: The Bek bridge collapses under the imperial train, and Manson stabs Adrian with a dagger.

1774-12-26/faunterra.label: 24–28 December 1774
1774-12-26/faunterra.t: Mira is proclaimed empress: with the Glove of Power, she makes peace with Erwin.

1775-01-15/faunterra.label: January 1775
1775-01-15/faunterra.t: Minerva is crowned in the half-ruined palace, and Erwin becomes lord chancellor.

1775-02-25/nen-kler.label: Late February 1775
1775-02-25/nen-kler.t: Francis-Ilian and a beggar who turns out to be Manson undergo the Lady in the Dark’s trials.

1775-03-15/faunterra.label: Spring 1775
1775-03-15/faunterra.t: The standoff on Holy Field: Minerva pardons the Snowdrops, and Erwin’s trap fails.

1775-03-20/lajem.label: March 1775
1775-03-20/lajem.t: Moger Buckley arrives in Laem with the Labelin fleet, tracking Harmon.

1775-04-15/ostrov-faradeya-rajli.label: Spring 1775
1775-04-15/ostrov-faradeya-rajli.t: Sybil lives at the sanatorium under the name Dorothy Sly, alongside Navi and Karen.

1775-05-06/marengo.label: 6–7 May 1775
1775-05-06/marengo.t: Minerva tests Erwin with Shavans at Marengo.

1775-05-17/faunterra.label: 17–29 May 1775
1775-05-17/faunterra.t: Manson’s trial: on 29 May he shouts that Adrian is alive, and the Chamber deposes Adrian.

1775-05-19/ruajld.label: 18–22 May 1775
1775-05-19/ruajld.t: Dorothy, Karen, and Navi flee the island and land at Rouaillde.

1775-05-21/bezdonnaya-propast.label: 20–28 May 1775
1775-05-21/bezdonnaya-propast.t: Harmon’s balloon is shot down over the Bottomless Abyss; the Hunter, the surviving Adrian, takes Quindar’s Abbey.

1775-05-27/uejmar.label: 27 May 1775
1775-05-27/uejmar.t: Iona raises a rebellion at Weimar Castle: Vittor gives a Finger to Harry Hogg, and the Northerners die.

1775-05-28/arden.label: 28 May 1775
1775-05-28/arden.t: Erwin’s ambush in the temple of Farewell: Paul’s brigade takes the Drop of the Sun.

1775-06-07/bek-most.label: 6–7 June 1775
1775-06-07/bek-most.t: Erwin defeats General Wexler’s ambush near Bek Castle.

1775-06-10/uejmar.label: 9–10 June 1775
1775-06-10/uejmar.t: Ice reaches Weimar with the Drop of the Sun: Iona recognizes her brother Richard.

1775-06-19/fliss.label: 14–19 June 1775
1775-06-19/fliss.t: Fighting near Fliss: Gordon Sue’s kairs hold at the Battle of the Cliff.

1775-06-21/uejmar.label: 20–22 June 1775
1775-06-21/uejmar.t: Joaquin shoots into the clouds: the slopes of Castle Hill vanish along with the besiegers.

1775-06-28/rej-roj.label: Late June 1775
1775-06-28/rej-roj.t: Paul declares himself a god, freezes Moran, and hands Fingers to the Shavans. Erwin’s horse Rain dies.

1775-07-15/fliss.label: July 1775
1775-07-15/fliss.t: At the gates of Fliss, Paul kills Mother Cordelia, and Gallard joins him.

1775-08-02/uejmar.label: 2 August 1775
1775-08-02/uejmar.t: Alanis stabs Paul with a stiletto and poisons Vittor and Gallard. Vittor returns to life and declares himself the Chosen One.

1775-08-15/faunterra.label: August 1775
1775-08-15/faunterra.t: Adrian returns to the capital without a fight and marries Magda Labelin; Minerva leaves with the treasury.

1775-08-30/pervaya-zima.label: Late August 1775
1775-08-30/pervaya-zima.t: Minerva arrives at First Winter and declares it the capital.

1775-09-15/fejris.label: September 1775
1775-09-15/fejris.t: Erwin crosses the County of the Mills as far as Fairis.

1775-10-03/lisij-dol.label: Early October 1775
1775-10-03/lisij-dol.t: Richard’s ambush at Fox Hollow: Craig Northwood dies.

1775-10-15/granenye.label: October 1775
1775-10-15/granenye.t: Erwin’s fleet drifts in the Sea of Ice near the Faceted Islands for a week.

1775-11-05/belomorye.label: Early November 1775
1775-11-05/belomorye.t: Erwin takes Count Fleming’s family hostage.

1775-11-20/lid.label: November 1775
1775-11-20/lid.t: The Horde sacks Leed and Gwenda dies. Erwin and Hyder Leed slip into the city and free Iona.

1775-11-22/majn.label: November 1775
1775-11-22/majn.t: In Main, Adrian tells Manson and Magda his plans for the Great Tree.

1775-12-02/pervaya-zima.label: 2 December 1775
1775-12-02/pervaya-zima.t: The Battle for First Winter: the Chosen One’s army is trapped in an ice maze, and Erwin is gravely wounded.

1775-12-02/grot-kosuli.label: 2 December 1775
1775-12-02/grot-kosuli.t: At the Roe Deer Grotto, Paul dies by his own deconstructor, and Navi falls into the chasm.

1775-12-03/pervaya-zima.label: Night before 3 December 1775
1775-12-03/pervaya-zima.t: Richard kills Gordon Sue and Desmond; Erwin kills his brother in a duel.

1775-12-04/majn.label: 3–4 December 1775
1775-12-04/majn.t: Adrian imprisons Vittor in the Womb.

1775-12-20/pervaya-zima.label: December 1775
1775-12-20/pervaya-zima.t: Minerva sends the Bird Without Flesh toward the Star, and Navi discovers the truth about the Foremothers. “The choice is yours.”
